notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR5: ALL REFERENCES OF identifier-1 runs the section "for every statement that explicitly references identifier-1": WRITE/REWRITE before the I-O after the FROM move, GO TO DEPENDING before the transfer, PERFORM VARYING/AFTER/UNTIL after each phase, otherwise after the statement, and not for a phrase not executed. DebugTriggerPlanner.PlanLeaf/PlanPerform/PlanPhrases/PlanInto choose the moment and DebugTriggerEmitter.Emit, LandBeforeIo and EmitLoopPhase place it; the witness covers MOVE, a read and GO TO DEPENDING before the procedure trigger. Probes at 85 (dbg/g5): DISPLAY X fires; MOVE X TO X X fires once (rule 7); a subscript TE (X) fires; GX OF G as qualifier does not (rule 9); COMPUTE X with SIZE ERROR fires; WRITE FR FROM A3 fires with FR=abc before the I-O; READ INTO A3 fires only when the record moved; an EVALUATE WHEN not evaluated does not fire; PERFORM VARYING X fires after init, each test and each augment; GO TO DEPENDING fires before DP's procedure trigger.

next.reason: 1985: "When the ALL REFERENCES OF identifier-1 phrase is specified, that debugging section is executed for every statement"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds USE FOR DEBUGGING; the USE candidate covers only exception declaratives (EXCEPTION-OBJECT)". No 2023 clause holds the Debug module's USE FOR DEBUGGING. The wording candidates cover READ, WRITE, PERFORM, MOVE and exception USE, not debugging-section timing, so the feature is dropped.
